description: This Java class `ClusterStatusSupplier` implements the `Supplier<ClusterStatus>` interface. It provides functionality to retrieve the current status of an Akka cluster by analyzing the cluster's members, roles, reachability, and leadership status. The class uses cluster configuration to filter roles and gathers detailed status information, including reachable and unreachable nodes, role statuses, and leadership info.

classes.name: ClusterStatusSupplier
classes.description: Provides the current status of an Akka cluster by inspecting member roles, reachability, leadership, and other cluster state details.

methods.name: ClusterStatusSupplier
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the supplier with a specific Akka Cluster instance and loads configuration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current ClusterStatus, including members, unreachable nodes, roles, and leader information.
